title: wall-healthcheck output
description: Checks whether hosts answer. Usage: wall-healthcheck TARGET [TARGET ...] [--attempts N] [--timeout-ms MS]. A TARGET is an IPv4 address (ICMP echo) or IP:PORT (TCP connect to that port). A host being down is a normal result, not an error.

status.description: ok: finished with no errors. partial: finished, result present but incomplete (see errors). error: failed, result is null.

result.description: Tool-specific payload; null when status is error.

allOf.$comment: partial -> at least one error, result present
error -> at least one error, result is null

schema_version.description: Contract version, MAJOR.MINOR. This file is the contract for major version 1: every 1.x document must validate against it.

name.description: Program that produced the document, e.g. "wall-scan".

version.description: Package version of that program (its git tag without the leading v). Independent of schema_version.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC with a Z suffix, e.g. "2026-10-08T09:30:00Z". Fractional seconds allowed.

code.description: Machine-readable snake_case code. Open set: new codes may appear in any minor version, so consumers must handle codes they do not know.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to show in the UI.

target.description: The input (usually an IP address) this error is about, or null for an error affecting the whole run.

params.description: The run-wide inputs. Each target's address and method are in its check entry.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for each probe, in milliseconds.

checks.description: One entry per target, in the order the targets were given.

method.description: icmp: echo request (ping). tcp: TCP connect to port, for hosts that drop ping, such as Windows PCs with the default firewall rules.

port.description: TCP port for method tcp; null for icmp.

up.description: true if at least one probe succeeded. For tcp, a refused connection counts as down: the host is reachable but the port is closed.

successes.description: Probes that succeeded, out of params.attempts. Below attempts while up means packet loss.

rtt_ms.description: Mean round-trip time of the successful probes, in milliseconds. For tcp, the time to complete the TCP handshake. null when down.

down_reason.description: Why the last probe failed, null when up. Open set; current values: timeout, refused, host_unreachable, network_unreachable, network_error (any other socket error).

allOf.$comment: port is set exactly for tcp checks
up -> rtt and no reason; down -> no rtt, a reason, zero successes
